revisions.note: 集石 wiki version of the ability (page updated 2026-07); English is our translation.

en.name: Baojun
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill a player neighboring a Minion, the next night you may choose up to 2 players: they die.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose up to two players: they die. The number of players you choose cannot be the same as the number of players who died last night (if more than two, count as two).
revisions.v2026-07: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill a player neighboring a Minion, the next night you may choose up to 2 players: they die.

zh.name: 暴君
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。如果你杀死了与爪牙邻近的玩家，下个夜晚你可以选择至多两名玩家：他们死亡。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚*，你可以选择至多两名玩家：他们死亡。你选择的玩家数量不能与上个夜晚死亡的玩家数量相同（超过二人时算作二人）。
revisions.v2026-07: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。如果你杀死了与爪牙邻近的玩家，下个夜晚你可以选择至多两名玩家：他们死亡。
